property_summary: For all calls to burn(uint256) the reference contract ensures only the owner can reduce balances/totalSupply (i.e., a non-owner's attempt to call burn will not succeed), while the mutant allows any caller to successfully burn their balance and reduce totalSupply.
change_summary: Removed the onlyOwner modifier requirement by replacing the function signature so anyone can call burn, allowing non-owners to reduce balances and totalSupply.
